Hummingbird.name: Hummingbird
Hummingbird.description:
No frills, just raw processing power.

2 slots only for Hardware

+1 to NET Actions each turn.

Kaliya.name: Kaliya
Kaliya.description:
A fantastic option for dismantling hostile Netrunners. Just hope they don’t have any Black ICE.

6 slots for Programs or Hardware, 3 extra slots only for Flak programs.

Restrictions for Defender Programs and Black ICE: Only Flak and Asp can be installed in any slot.

Kerberos.name: Kerberos
Kerberos.description:
Unleash the fires of Hell upon your rivals.

6 slots for Programs, 5 slots for Hardware.

Program slots will only accept Hellhound Black ICE.

Kestrel 2.name: Kestrel 2
Kestrel 2.description:
Black ICE can’t hit what they can’t catch.

7 slots only for Programs.

Right after Jacking In, Netrunner can activate a maximum of 2 installed Speedy Gonzalvez Programs without a NET Action.

Kirama Advanced Deck.name: Kirama Advanced Deck
Kirama Advanced Deck.description:
Though it may not be the flashiest choice, Kirama’s finest Cyberdeck is expertly balanced and offers some highly practical safety features.

5 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Netrunner suffers no negative effects from an Unsafe Jack Out.

Kirama Entry Deck.name: Kirama Entry Deck
Kirama Entry Deck.description:
An affordable and balanced Cyberdeck for novice Netrunners. Though limited by its modest hardware specs, it retains the advanced safety features of Kirama’s flagship Cyberdecks.

5 slots only for Programs.

Only one of each Program category can be installed at a time (Attacker, Defender, Booster, Black ICE). Netrunner suffers no negative effects from an Unsafe Jack Out.

Kirama Training Deck.name: Kirama Training Deck
Kirama Training Deck.description:
The quintessential starter Cyberdeck. Bargain-bin price with bare-minimum hardware specs.

5 slots only for Programs.

Netrunner must be 2m/yds or closer to Access Point to Jack In. All brain damage from NET combat is doubled.

MicroMate.name: MicroMate
MicroMate.description:
Perfect for Netrunners who only know one speed: All offense, all the time. Just don't get hit, it's going to hurt. A lot.

9 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Slots will not accept Defender Programs. All brain damage from NET combat is doubled.

Microtech Assault.name: Microtech Assault
Microtech Assault.description:
Relax and let your Black ICE do all the heavy lifting.

4 slots for Programs, 5 slots for Hardware.

Program slots only accept Black ICE.

Microtech Scout.name: Microtech Scout
Microtech Scout.description:
5 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Netrunner can roll Pathfinder without a NET Action right after Jacking In.

Microtech Warrior.name: Microtech Warrior
Microtech Warrior.description:
7 Slots only for Programs.

Netrunner can activate one Armor Program without a NET Action right after Jacking In.

Parraline 6000.name: Parraline 6000
Parraline 6000.description:
All the Hardware options with none of the restrictions.

3 Program slots, 6 Hardware slots.

Phoenix.name: Phoenix
Phoenix.description:
Never lose a Program again.

6 slots for Programs or Hardware.

Any Program destroyed in a netrunning session is restored upon a safe Jack Out.

Verdant Knight.name: Verdant Knight
Verdant Knight.description:
The classic sword-and-board Cyberdeck build is highly effective against Black ICE. Just don’t plan on going toe-to-toe with a hostile Netrunner.

9 slots only for Programs.

Slots only accept Sword or Shield Programs.

Warlock's Book.name: Warlock's Book
Warlock's Book.description:
If you prefer sliding through NET Architectures avoiding Black ICE this is the deck for you.

9 slots to install either Programs or Hardware.

No Attacker or Black ICE Program may be installed.

Integrated Cyberscanner.name: Integrated Cyberscanner
Integrated Cyberscanner.description: Can scan an individual within 2m/yds and provide a list of all installed Cyberware, takes 1 minute. Spits out an error if a Hardened, Tech Upgraded, or Unique piece of Cyberware is detected.

A Touch of Luxury Furniture Set.name: Ein Hauch von Luxus Möbelset
A Touch of Luxury Furniture Set.description: Möbel, mit denen sich dein Frachtcontainer fast wie ein Zuhause anfühlt.

Bullet To Slug Adapter Casings.name: Kugel-zu-Flintenpatrone-Adapterhülsen
Bullet To Slug Adapter Casings.description:
Make any bullet able to be fired as a shotgun slug.

A box of Bullet to Slug Adapter Casings comes with 10 casings.

You can load 10 bullets into 10 adapters using the included jig in an Action. If loading by hand it takes an Action to load 1 bullet.

Cargo Container Chic Furniture Set.name: Frachtcontainer-Chic Möbelset
Cargo Container Chic Furniture Set.description: Günstig, aber echte Möbel. Das Starter-Set der meisten Frachtcontainer.

Cybercam EX-1.name: Cybercam EX-1
Cybercam EX-1.description: Head-mounted camera. A Media presenting a story on a livestream while wearing the Cybercam EX-1 gains +1 Believability when using their role ability. This stacks with evidence based bonuses.

Cyberscanner.name: Cyberscanner
Cyberscanner.description: Can scan an individual within 2m/yds and provide a list of all installed Cyberware, takes 1 minute. Spits out an error if a Hardened, Tech Upgraded, or Unique piece of Cyberware is detected.

Delaying Compound.name: Delaying Compound
Delaying Compound.description: This additive delays the effects of a Poison or Biotoxin Vial by a minute or an hour. Mixing multiple Delaying Compounds does not increase delay period.

Distilling Compound.name: Distilling Compound
Distilling Compound.description: This additive increases the Resist Torture/Drugs DV of Poison or Biotoxin Vials by 2. Mixing multiple Distilling Compounds does not increase Resist Torture/Drugs DV beyond the initial +2.

Drink Master 5000.name: Drink Master 5000
Drink Master 5000.description: A large, cabinet-sized, drink mixing machine seen commonly used in bars.

Fire Safe.name: Feuersafe
Fire Safe.description:
Kleiner Tresor aus Dickem Stahl.

  • 50 TP
  • 30cm / 1ft
  • Kann mit einem Wurf auf Schloss knacken gegen SG 15 geknackt werden

GRAF3.name: GRAF3
GRAF3.description:
Vierbeinige Konstruktionsdrohne.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 59 von Interface Red vol. 1.

Hidden Compartment.name: Verborgenes Fach
Hidden Compartment.description:
Ein kleines, verstecktes Fach im Frachtcontainer.

  • 15.25×30×7.5cm / 6×12×3 Zoll
  • Kann mit einem Wurf auf Objekt verbergen/entdecken mit SG 15 entdeckt werden

Inline Skates.name: Inline Skates
Inline Skates.description: They're roller skates baby! Increases moment by 4 m/yds when using the Run Action, though stopping the use of any options in the user's legs. May cause physical tasks to be done at -2.

Ion Cuffs.name: Ion Cuffs
Ion Cuffs.description: Handcuffs meant for borgs. Disables any Non-Hardened Cyberware options installed in the limb the cuffs are binding. BODY≥13 can break.

Koff Popper.name: Koff-Popper
Koff Popper.description:
Der Continental Brands Koff-Popper ist die einzige Spezialthermoskanne, die du in deinem Leben brauchst.

  • Thermoskanne mit eingebautem Koff-Pop-Brüher
  • Fasst 237ml / 8oz
  • Nur erhältlich bei Oasis-Geschäften

Koff Pops.name: Koff-Pops
Koff Pops.description:
Koff-Pops für den Continental Brands Koff-Popper. 

  • 10er-Packung
  • In allen Lebensstilen ab Kibble oder höher bereits eingerechnet

MagViewer.name: MagViewer
MagViewer.description:
Binoculars meant for spotting. Provides detail up to 800m/yds. Provides the user with an additional +1 to an attack roll with a successful Complimentary Skill Check to assist in attacking a target 51m/yds or farther away in addition to any other Complimentary Skill Checks..

Does not stack with @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_upgrades.Item.Ryex0KHeeDzPQwmN]{Sniping Scope} or @UUID[Compendium.cyberpunk-red-core.core_cyberware.Item.uApwuxpuIJMe47Vn]{TeleOptics}.

Master Mechanic's Tool Kit.name: Master Mechanic's Tool Kit
Master Mechanic's Tool Kit.description: Massive Tool Chest. Provides a +4 to multiple skills when rolling Maker Skill Checks. Large enough to be considered Thick Steel Cover, requires BODY 10 to move.

Mercurius Cyberchair.name: Mercurius-Cyberstuhl
Mercurius Cyberchair.description:
Ein erschwinglicher Cyberstuhl mit für den Preis beeindruckenden Funktionen. Während der Nutzung beträgt die Basis-BEW des Nutzers 5, wobei alle regulären Bewegungsoptionen nutzbar bleiben.

Die Steuerung des Cyberstuhls benötigt entweder eine freie Hand oder Interface-Buchsen.

Wenn der Nutzer eine Kritische Verletzung erleidet, die die BEW verringert, betrifft dies stattdessen die BEW des Cyberstuhls.

Der Cyberstuhl kann nicht spezifisch anvisiert werden und nicht durch EMP-Effekte ausgeschaltet werden.

MiniMag Speakers.name: MiniMag Speakers
MiniMag Speakers.description: Small Magnetic Speakers. Can play audio from a connected Agent within 100m/yds.

My First GRAF3.name: Meine erste GRAF3
My First GRAF3.description:
Persönliche Drohne. Winzige GRAF3, die mit einem Agenten verbunden werden kann.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 61 von Interface Red vol. 1.

Osmosis Compound.name: Osmosis Compound
Osmosis Compound.description:
This additive allows a Vial of Poison or Biotoxin to be absorbed through skin contact. One vial can cover 2 square feet when applied to a surface and lasts for one hour. Can be neutralized by rinsing with water. 

The first meat target to touch the affected area with a meat body part is dosed with the poison. A DV17 Perception check reveals the poison. More than one dose in the same 2 square foot area has no added effect.

Savannah Eagle.name: Savannah Eagle
Savannah Eagle.description:
Aktive luftgestützte Verteidigungsdrohne.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 60 von Interface Red vol. 1.

Savannah Panther.name: Savannah Panther
Savannah Panther.description:
Aktive Verteidigungsdrohne.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 61 von Interface Red vol. 1.

Second-hand Special Furniture Set.name: Gebrauchtes Möbelset
Second-hand Special Furniture Set.description: Nicht hübsch, aber funktional. Dieses Möbelset ist das absolute Minimum, das dein Frachtcontainer braucht.

Skateboard.name: Skateboard
Skateboard.description: The coolest wheels around. Increases moment by 4 m/yds when using the Run Action on level or downwards ground. May cause physical tasks to be done at -2.

Smart Vanity.name: Smart-Kosmetiktisch
Smart Vanity.description: Smarte Frisierstation. Vollständig ausgestattet mit Werkzeugen und Kosmetik.

Smartsticks.name: Smartsticks
Smartsticks.description: Smart Drum Sticks. Gives the User a +1 bonus to Play Instrument (Drums) Skill Checks while in use. Doesn't stack with other bonuses to Play Instrument.

Solo of Fortune Bodypillow.name: Solo of Fortune Bodypillow
Solo of Fortune Bodypillow.description:
Körperkissen mit dem Bild eines berühmten Solos der 2020er (wie Morgan Blackhand, BoaBoa Weyland oder Adam Smasher).

20x 54 Zoll (50.8 cm x 137.16 cm), außer das für Adam Smasher, das ist bedeutend größer.

Spider Cyberchair.name: Spinnen-Cyberstuhl
Spider Cyberchair.description:
Der Spitzen-Cyberstuhl mit Unmengen Optionen für den versierten Nutzer. Während der Nutzung beträgt die Basis-BEW des Nutzers 5, wobei alle regulären Bewegungsoptionen nutzbar bleiben.

Zusätzlich verfügt dieser Cyberstuhl über Platz für 4 Cybergliedmaßen-Optionen*. Alle installierten Optionen gelten immer als paarweise.

Die Steuerung des Cyberstuhls benötigt entweder eine freie Hand oder Interface-Buchsen.

Wenn der Nutzer eine Kritische Verletzung erleidet, die die BEW verringert, betrifft dies stattdessen die BEW des Cyberstuhls.

Der Cyberstuhl kann nicht spezifisch anvisiert werden und nicht durch EMP-Effekte ausgeschaltet werden.

*Installation von Cybergliedmaßen-Optionen aktuell nicht unterstützt

Suzumebachi Assassin Drone.name: Suzumebachi Assassin Drone
Suzumebachi Assassin Drone.description:
A small wasp-shaped drone designed for silent assassinations.

Stats: 6 MOVE - 7SP - 10HP.

Can be neutralized in 5 min with a DV17 Electronic/Security Tech check.

Default Programming:

  1. Locate target using onboard camera.
  2. Attack target with dartgun until ammo is depleted or target's infrared                 signature no longer detected
  3. Exfiltrate and return to operator

Drone is commonly controlled with a NET Architecture.

Range:

Perimeter of a NET Architecture-equipped building or 50m/yds away from a portable NET Architecture.

Loadout:

  • Camera with low Light, UV, Infrared modes
  • Dartgun with 8 Biotoxin Arrows
  • Airhypo

The Observer.name: The Observer (Beobachter)
The Observer.description:
Persönliche Drohne. Fliegende Kamera, die mit einem Agenten verbunden werden kann.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 62 von Interface Red vol. 1.

The Transporter.name: The Transporter
The Transporter.description:
Persönliche Drohne. Transportdrohne, die mit einem Agenten verbunden werden kann.

Siehe volle Beschreibung auf Seite 63 von Interface Red vol. 1.

Umbrella.name: Regenschirm
Umbrella.description:
Schützt vor Säureregen. Säureregen trägt pro Minute 1 SW von aller Rüstung ab (NCW S. 4).

+2 auf Folter/Drogen widerstehen gegen Blutregen. Schwerer Blutregen hat bei Misserfolg die Wirkung einer Flasche mit Biotoxin. (NCW S. 4).
